Chinese AI labs are now mainly tapping OpenAI's most powerful model, GPT-6 Astra, instead of Anthropic's Claude. According to The Information, DeepSeek and Moonshot AI leaned heavily on Astra's outputs to train their latest models. People familiar with the matter say this includes Kimi K3.1 Pro and V4.1-Flash 1017.

This kind of distillation only works if the labs get the models to reveal their hidden reasoning steps. OpenAI and Anthropic both ban that. Moonshot declined to comment, and DeepSeek didn't respond to a request for comment. Claude used to be the go-to target, but Anthropic has tightened its defenses. The company says its new methods cut the amount of data attackers can pull by 90 to 99 percent.

In late September, OpenAI reported a coordinated distillation campaign that it says involved people linked to Moonshot. An OpenAI spokesperson said the company takes the problem very seriously, but until now attackers adjusted their tactics every time it rolled out a new defense.

translation.html:
中国 AI 实验室如今主要利用 OpenAI 最强大的模型 GPT-6 Astra，而非 Anthropic 的 Claude。据 The Information 报道，DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI 大量使用 Astra 的输出训练其最新模型。知情人士称，这些模型包括 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 V4.1-Flash 1017。

只有当实验室让模型透露其隐藏的推理步骤时，这种蒸馏才会奏效。OpenAI 和 Anthropic 都禁止这种做法。Moonshot 拒绝置评，DeepSeek 则未回应置评请求。Claude 曾是首选目标，但 Anthropic 已加强防护。该公司表示，其新方法使攻击者能够提取的数据量减少了 90% 至 99%。

9 月下旬，OpenAI 报告了一场有组织的蒸馏行动，称其中涉及与 Moonshot 有关联的人士。OpenAI 的一位发言人表示，公司非常重视这一问题，但迄今为止，每当公司推出新的防御措施，攻击者都会调整策略。
